label: sparse end-of-input / <DEL> feature in long sequences starting with d/i/b/h (trigger unresolved)
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps). It fires only at the original-to-copy boundary: the last two original tokens, the <DEL> step, and the first copy step (t in [L-2, L+1]). It is strongly enriched in long sequences (L=8-9 hold about 82% of mass) and in sequences whose first token is d or i (about 73% of mass), with some b and h. It never fires at t<=2 or later in the copy phase. The window plus first-token condition captures about 75% of activation mass, but only about 1% of the predicted steps are active, and even the tightest context tried (L=9, first token d/i, t in {L-1, L}) reaches only 5% precision. Which specific token content triggers it was not identified: the letter o or g appearing in the sequence was tried and did not help. Magnitude varies little (median 0.12, max 0.23) and no modulator was found.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=d (+5.58), orig0=i (+5.43), orig0=b (+3.96), orig0=h (+3.46), orig2=o (+3.18), orig1=j (+2.80). Lower it: phase=2 (-6.22), prev3_tok=- (-4.35), orig4=s (-3.08), orig3=r (-2.78).
